children: The European Central Bank might need to raise interest rates further and bring them to a level that mildly curbs the economy, ECB policymaker Joachim Nagel said in a CNBC interview on Friday.
The Bundesbank's president added the ECB's future decisions would depend on how energy prices develop and it was too early to speculate on any move.
